Company Description
 Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
 Job Description
 The Player Domain sits at the heart of our data infrastructure, tackling the complex challenges generated by player-facing services at scale. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the team and help us build robust, reliable data foundations that power smarter decisions across the studio.
You will work closely with both technical and business stakeholders, bringing a strong engineering mindset and a collaborative spirit to everything you do.
 What You'll Do
Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines by ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, systems, and formats. 
Deploy data products into production environments, applying best practices for monitoring, integration testing, and release management. 
Guarantee data quality and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation across all data products. 
Provide technical support and expertise to both technical and business teams, acting as a reliable point of contact for data-related challenges. 
Collaborate with business and IT teams to define use cases, refine requirements, and design scalable data pipeline solutions. 
Contribute to code reviews, testing, and the continuous improvement of internal tools and processes. 
Propose new ideas and innovative approaches to drive the evolution of our data engineering practices. 
 Qualifications
 What You'll Bring 
 Experience & Knowledge
Solid hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on data integration, modeling, optimization, and quality management within an Agile environment. 
A good understanding of game-specific elements (PvP, PvE, co-op) and monetization mechanisms (season pass, vanity items, soft currency, etc.) is a plus. 
 Technical Skills
Proficiency in SQL and Python 
Experience with ETL/ELT orchestration tools such as Airflow or equivalent 
Knowledge of Power BI 
Hands-on experience with Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks 
Familiarity with Data Observability practices and tools 
Version control with Git 
 Interpersonal Skills
Clear, effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, tailored to the audience. 
Collaborative mindset with a strong sense of service and ownership. 
Autonomous, adaptable, and proactive — comfortable driving work forward and seeking support when needed.
